description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

CGI is an IT and business consulting services firm seeking an Associate S/4HANA SAP ABAP Developer to support a government-contract SAP S/4HANA Greenfield implementation. The role involves designing and developing ABAP solutions, integrating S/4HANA with external systems, analyzing requirements and performance, and participating in testing and documentation within an Agile/Scrum environment.
SAP S/4HANA ABAP developer focused on integrations, OData, and testing

Responsibilities:
• Design and develop comprehensive solutions within the S/4HANA platform, ensuring scalability, performance, and alignment with complex business objectives
• Develop and manage integrations between S/4HANA and external systems using advanced technologies and protocols, ensuring seamless data flow and interoperability
• Analyze and enhance system performance and business processes within S/4HANA, leveraging advanced tools and techniques to maximize efficiency and effectiveness
• Utilize SAP Gateway Service Builder to develop SAP OData entities, enabling consumption by external applications using the HTTP(s) protocol
• Participate in the analysis of customer business operations to validate requirements and scope, proactively suggesting process improvements
• Work closely with business and technical teams to gather and analyze requirements, translating them into effective S/4HANA solutions that align with organizational goals
• Develop and maintain detailed SAP documentation, conducting thorough unit, integration, and release testing to validate functionality and ensure quality

Requirements:
• • Due to the nature of the contract requirements, this position requires U.S. citizenship
• • Candidates must also have the ability to obtain and maintain a DHS EOD/Public Trust clearance
• • Experience working with Web Services, Proxies, and APIs for seamless system integration
• • Knowledge and hands-on experience in debugging and performance tuning of ABAP programs
• • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present and discuss strategies and technical information in a way that builds rapport and supports understanding for both technical and non-technical audiences
• • Ability to analyze problems and provide clear recommendations
• • Capable of self-learning new technologies in the UI space, working with minimal direction and supervision
• * SAP ABAP

Preferred:
• • Up to 1 year of experience in SAP ABAP development and overall SAP exposure is preferred but not mandatory
• • Familiarity with S/4HANA is a plus
• • Basic understanding of integrating backend SAP and non-SAP applications is desirable
• • Exposure to SAP ABAP development and HANA CDS Views is advantageous
• • Interest or foundational knowledge in SAP Fiori and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) is beneficial
• • Exposure to a wide range of ABAP technologies, including Reports, RFCs, Forms, Object-Oriented ABAP (OOP), BAPIs, Enhancements, BADIs, User Exits, Customer Exits, and Data Conversions (BDC, LSMW, IDocs, ALE, and Workflows)
• • Experience with the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP)
• • Certifications related to Application Development, SAP BTP, or Agile methodologies
